name: Kazama Takuya
source:
A patient suffering from [url=/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilson%27s_disease]Wilson's disease[/url]. He resides in the same hospital as [url=/c87869]Suzune[/url].

[spoiler]His birthday is on 4/28, the day of the game's events. He dies two days later at 15 years old, and his heart is transplanted into Suzune.[/spoiler]
